reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: An application has recently been submitted for the proposed refurbishment and minor alterations of the building for the use of Brighton College Prep Kensington, by Cognita Schools Ltd; 04/08768/LBC internal alterations at basement, ground and first to third floor levels; 13/04631/LBC installation of new toilet facilities at the third floor, minor roof level alterations comprising the erection of a balustrade system, walkway and extract flues at roof level; 13/01711/LBC & 10/01710/FULL change of use of the fourth floor to provide residential accommodation; 90/06655/FULL change of use from diplomatic/embassy to a non residential institution (class D1); 89/06951/LBC rebuilding of damaged roof structures and general restoration and repair; installation of smoke detection, (it is understood that the brass staircase handrail was provided at that time)
description: Emergency works to existing balustrading to strengthen the existing balustrading and provision of a raised handrail and provision of additional fire stopping.
